summary: Backend + Frontend testing for Circolo Vizioso single-page site. All 3 backend pytest cases pass (GET /api/, POST /api/reservations + GET verify, minimal-payload defaults). Frontend flows verified via Playwright on the public URL with ?static=1: hero + CTA visible, floating nav present, all 5 sections in DOM, i18n switcher toggles IT->EN->DE->FR correctly (Storia/Story/Geschichte/Histoire), Menu tabs cucina/pizza/vini render menu-item rows (26/26/16) with Bottiglia/Calice on vini, Gallery lightbox opens & closes, floating WhatsApp and nav-reserve buttons href=wa.me/3903321313742, reservation form validation toast fires on empty submit, filled submit POSTs to /api/reservations (record persisted, verified via GET) and opens WhatsApp URL in a popup.

ui_bugs.issue: Rendered hero title reads 'È comestarea casa' (missing whitespace between split spans) when accessed with ?static=1. Likely CSS/animation split-letter styling collapsing spaces. Verify space handling in Hero SplitText.

No found inside #menu when pizza tab active (query '#menu img' returned none). Spec expects a pizza image on the pizza tab. Confirm background-image vs usage; if it's a CSS background this may be acceptable, but a real with alt is recommended for a11y.

action_items: Investigate hero title spacing: 'È come stare a casa' rendered as 'È comestarea casa' with static mode — likely SplitText not preserving spaces.
Consider adding a real in the pizza menu tab (currently no element detected in #menu).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string then converts back on GET; consistent but adds overhead — acceptable for simplicity.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler.
Reservation model has no server-side validation of guests/date/time formats — inputs are accepted as plain strings and int. Consider Pydantic validators.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 reservations prefixed TEST_ in MongoDB via API during tests (TEST_Mario, TEST_Minimal, TEST_Playwright).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ?static=1 to skip preloader for reliable UI tests. Public URL is https://alpine-heritage-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Reservation form POST reaches /api/reservations and also opens wa.me popup; expect_popup works. Hero title has a possible whitespace issue when static=1 is used.
